target_customer: Engineering teams building web apps on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket that pay for CI/CD and preview environments
problem: CI runs and end-to-end tests are slow and preview environments are hard to set up. webapp.io used memory snapshots and a custom hypervisor to make full-stack environments start in seconds from a Dockerfile-like Layerfile.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for CI/CD and preview environments
product_category: Developer tools, CI/CD and preview environments

founders.name: Colin Chartier
education: University of Toronto, triple major in computer science, statistics and math (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC bio: full-stack, system design and DevOps. Site footer credits Colin Chartier 2019-2025; PitchBook says formerly known as LayerCI.

founders.name: Lyn Chen
previous_startups: Unnamed developer tools company (acquired, per YC bio)
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A custom hypervisor with memory snapshot reuse to start full-stack environments in seconds is systems-level work for a team of four, per the YC description.

defensibility.rationale: The speed advantage came from snapshot tech, but CI and preview environments were a crowded category and customers could move Layerfile-style configs to rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it. The company's homepage says it joined Harness, with a post titled that webapp.io is shutting down, date not stated.

market_need_then: Slow CI and the cost of per-branch environments were common developer complaints. No dated 2020 source was opened that quantifies spend.

branding.domain_note: Uses webapp.io (.io domain). Earlier name LayerCI, still live at layerci.com per search results; rebrand date not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain developer marketing, tagline 10x Better DevOps for Webapps

brand_strength.rationale: Generic descriptive name and no press or community on the brand found. The product name Layerfile was more distinctive.

outcome_analysis: webapp.io joined Y Combinator in Summer 2020 with a fast snapshot based CI product. Its own homepage later said it joined Harness and linked to a post about shutting down, so the outcome reads as an acquisition that ended the standalone product. Price, date and Harness role were not found and the Harness claim comes only from the company site, so the soft landing label is a tentative reading.
notes: Harness acquisition seen only on webapp.io homepage banner; a press search found no Harness coverage. Funding unverified: PitchBook lists 30K and 150K accelerator entries and 180K total, CB Insights lists 600K total with Thiel Fellowship, FundersClub, YC and Soma Capital. Founding year 2019 vs 2020 conflicts. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found.
